【原视频简介】
AI 3D Generation Showcase: DSV4.1, GPT-6, and Blender MCP Demonstrations

Video Breakdown:

0:00 – 1:10 | DSV4.1 Mechanical City Webpage: The demonstration opens with the DSV4.1 model generating a highly detailed, interactive 3D webpage. The central focus is a wind-up music box featuring a mechanical city on a tabletop. The 3D environment showcases dynamic elements like spinning gears, a rotating Ferris wheel, and an adjustable, glowing internal light source. A side control panel allows the user to manipulate rendering settings, lighting intensity, and rotation speed in real-time.

1:10 – 1:54 | GPT-6 Astra Clockwork City: The video transitions to a "GPT 6 Astra" interface, which generates a visually distinct take on the same prompt. This 3D webpage features a stylized, pastel-toned clockwork city situated on a circular music box base. The model includes animated windmills, a clock tower, and a Ferris wheel. The interface on the right side provides sliders and toggles to adjust environmental settings, daylight conditions, and automated camera panning.

1:54 – 2:34 | DSV4.1 Blender MCP Image-to-3D Conversion: The final segment shifts from web generation to 3D asset creation. It starts with a single 2D reference image of a dark, futuristic tank. Using DSV4.1 routed through the Blender Model Context Protocol (MCP), the flat image is converted into a fully structured 3D model directly inside the Blender workspace. The video proves the model's depth by panning around the tank and toggling through different viewport shading options, revealing a complex wireframe mesh that accurately reflects the original 2D design.
👇 Let me know in the comments: Which AI built the better 3D racing game?…
